top_news.title: MAX models can now run on Apple silicon GPUs
top_news.dek: Modular's MAX platform now supports running AI models directly on Apple silicon GPUs.
top_news.brief: The 26.4 release expands MAX's hardware support, allowing developers to execute MAX graphs on Apple silicon. This update builds on previous Mojo-based GPU programming capabilities, aiming to improve portability and performance for AI infrastructure on Apple hardware.
top_news.image_alt: Modular MAX logo and Apple silicon hardware integration graphic

top_news.title: OverFlowLight: Real-Time Gridlock Prevention and Traffic Signal Optimization for Urban Intersections
top_news.dek: OverFlowLight is a new traffic signal control framework designed to prevent urban gridlock by preemptively managing intersection queue overflow.
top_news.brief: Current traffic signal control algorithms often prioritize throughput, which can lead to cascading gridlocks when queues exceed capacity. OverFlowLight introduces a real-time detection and mitigation mechanism to resolve these overflows before they obstruct upstream traffic, aiming to improve overall intersection performance during peak hours.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing traffic flow optimization at an urban intersection

top_news.title: Ford rehires ‘gray beard’ engineers after AI falls short
top_news.dek: Ford is rehiring experienced engineers after finding that AI-driven development failed to deliver expected product quality.
top_news.brief: Ford leadership acknowledged that relying solely on AI to replace traditional engineering processes resulted in quality issues. The company is now bringing back veteran engineers to restore oversight and technical rigor in their product development cycles.

top_news.title: GLM 5.2 beats Claude in our benchmarks
top_news.dek: Zhipu AI's GLM 5.2 model outperformed Claude Code on internal cybersecurity benchmarks for IDOR vulnerability detection.
top_news.brief: In recent testing, GLM 5.2 achieved a 39% F1 score on IDOR detection, surpassing Claude Code's 32%. While still trailing specialized multimodal pipelines, the results highlight the increasing capability of open-weight models in specific coding and security tasks compared to frontier closed-source models.
top_news.image_alt: Bar chart comparing model performance on IDOR detection benchmarks

primary.title: Sina's open model VibeThinker-3B aims to show reasoning compresses well but factual knowledge doesn't
primary.summary: Sina Weibo's VibeThinker-3B has just three billion parameters but matches models like DeepSeek V3.2 and Kimi K2.5 on math and coding benchmarks. Those models are up to 333 times larger. The secret isn't size but multi-stage post-training. The researchers propose a hypothesis based on their findings: logical reasoning compresses well into small models, but broad world knowledge does not.
